newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to auction six-month maturity bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to auction six-month maturity bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Monday it had invited bids up to Wednesday for the auction of six-month maturity short-term federal bonds.

The result of the auction will be announced on Thursday with settlement set for Saturday, it said. A pre-auction target had been set at four billion rupees but bids could be rejected without giving any reason.
In the previous auction held on December 31, bids worth 1.092 billion rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 16.9500 percent per annum. -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
